climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.
land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: A tiny northern Rhône appellation in the Rhône Valley, of 9.4 acres, owned by a single winery. It makes white wine from Viognier and is effectively an enclave within Condrieu, which also makes Viognier-only whites.
